paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper presents world-leading constraints on axion-photon coupling from spectropolarimetric observations of five magnetic white dwarfs (MWDs) using Lick/Kast and Keck/LRISp-ADC instruments. The most constraining observation is SDSS J033320+000720 (Lick), yielding |g_agamma| ≲ 1.7 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for masses m_a ≲ 2 × 10^-7 eV. The signal is approximately mass-independent for m_a ≪ 10^-6 eV (as stated in text: 'The axion-induced linear polarization signal is proportional to g_agamma^2 and is approximately independent of m_a for m_a ≪ 10^-6 eV'). Encoded as a horizontal line spanning the stated validity range [0, 2×10^-7 eV]. No evidence for axion-induced polarization was found; limits are derived from non-detection. This is an astrophysical stellar constraint, not a dark matter haloscope experiment, so no local DM density is assumed.
